An Iranian singer has been flogged 74 times for performing without a hijab. Parastoo Ahmadi, 29, was punished alongside four male members of her concert team over a performance she released online in December 2024. The video, which showed her singing without a headscarf and alongside male musicians, went viral, drawing millions of views and putting her at odds with Iran’s strict laws governing women’s public appearances and performances. Samah Qundeel explains the reasons behind her sentence.
